name: Locate My Device
tagline: Find your lost phone using a simple text message
description:
Locate My Device mimics Google's Find My Device feature, but it works through plain SMS text messages instead of needing an internet connection or a Google account. If your phone goes missing, you send it a text, and it texts back its location.

It's a lightweight, open-source safety net for anyone who wants a simple way to track down a lost or stolen phone.
